result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast problem: white heading and subtitle text sit on a very pale mint-green background, making the offer details nearly unreadable. A minor styling inconsistency exists between the favorite (heart) buttons on the popular cards.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, both the headline and the subtitle ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are rendered in white/near-white on a very light mint-green background. The contrast ratio is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer text and promo code are effectively illegible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green/near-black) on the light banner background, or darken/saturate the banner background so white text achieves at least 4.5:1 contrast (3:1 for large headline text).

issues.description: The favorite/heart button treatment is inconsistent between cards: on the Tokumaru Ramen card the heart icon appears without a visible circular backdrop, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark translucent circle. This makes the control look different across identical card types.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent backdrop (e.g., a semi-transparent dark or light circle) to the heart button on all cards so the affordance and contrast remain uniform regardless of the underlying image.
